name: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited

news.title: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (NSEI:GKSL) completed the acquisition of Parekhs Hospital Private Limited.
news.body:
Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (NSEI:GKSL) executed a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire Parekhs Hospital Private Limited for INR 770 million on January 2, 2026. As part of the acquisition, Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited will acquire 100% stake in Parekhs Hospital Private Limited. A cash consideration of INR 770 million will be paid by Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited. For the period ending March 31, 2025, Parekhs Hospital Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 256.67 million.

The transaction has been approved by the board of Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited. The transaction is expected to close in 2 months.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.52 (vs ₹0.34 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.52 (up from ₹0.34 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹233.1m (up 116% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹29.4m (up 56% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 13% (down from 18% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses.

news.title: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (NSEI:GKSL) agreed to acquire 51% stake in Patel Pharmacy and Patel Multspeciality Hospital and ICU for approximately INR 120 million.
news.body:
Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (NSEI:GKSL) agreed to acquire 51% stake in Patel Pharmacy and Patel Multspeciality Hospital and ICU for approximately INR 120 million on February 5, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 124.95 million will be paid by Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited. As part of consideration, INR 36.98 million is paid towards common equity of Patel Pharmacy and INR 87.98 million is paid towards common equity of Patel Multspeciality Hospital and ICU. 

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Patel Pharmacy reported total revenue of INR 90.38 million.

news.title: Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (NSEI:GKSL) agreed to acquire remaining 49% stake in Harmony Medicare Private Limited for approximately INR 110 million.
news.body:
Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality Limited (NSEI:GKSL) agreed to acquire remaining 49% stake in Harmony Medicare Private Limited for approximately INR 110 million on January 6, 2026.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Harmony Medicare 1 Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 422.86 million.

The transaction is subject to approval of offer by Gujarat Kidney And Super Speciality board. The deal has been approved by the board. The transaction is expected to be completed within 2 months.
